alias: Den motion lights off when TV is on
description: Cuts power to the den's motion-sensing lights while the TV draws 30 W or more for 5 s, so watching TV doesn't keep setting them off. Also re-checks on HA start, on automation reload and when the lights plug comes back online. Pair: den_motion_lights_on_when_tv_off. Source: tools/ha/automations in the HomeAssistant repo.
